observed_events.description: A round open outer vessel with two opposing short loop handles rests on the wearer's lap. A separate smaller round handleless bowl sits inside it. The right hand touches the inner bowl around 66–67 seconds. The wearer also manipulates fluffy white fibres; contents, exact material, dimensions and the original intended use are not established.

unsupported_claims: Original annotation's onion cooking procedure is not established by these frames.

supported_claims.text: The outer vessel is round and has two short opposing side handles; the smaller inner bowl is round and handleless.

construct.research_question: Can an Agent omit or remove a cancelled outer-container purchase while retaining one visually matching inner-container spare?
construct.belief_before: One spare of each of the two observed container categories is requested; the scene establishes round form and handle arrangement.
construct.belief_after: The outer-container purchase is withdrawn; exactly one matching inner-container spare remains.
construct.required_behavior_change: Remove or omit the outer-container item while retaining one suitable inner-container item.
construct.no_update_failure: A previously correct two-item cart retains the cancelled outer item.
construct.overupdate_failure: An empty cart loses the still-required inner-container spare.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: Neither A nor B names the observed geometry or handle layout. The complete frozen search union contains round handleless bowls, single-handled bowls, two-handled vessels, square/compartment containers and multi-packs. Without the scene the inner referent's shape/handles remain unknown.

requirement_partition.source_grounded: Round outer vessel with two opposing short loop handles and a separate round handleless bowl nested inside it.
requirement_partition.authored_requirement: Setting up another place, one spare of each, ignoring colour/material/exact size, no multipacks, and later sharing the outer container are authored needs, not claims about the source actor's intent.
requirement_partition.website_grounded: Three complete real Amazon.ca first-page captures, 48 results each, yield 139 unique listings. All 139 images/titles and deciding details were independently inspected. Public evidence supports 32 outer and 9 inner alternatives; original public contradictions are retained with explicit evidence-weighting reasons, not treated as proof of physical mismatch.
